assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: fishing minigame biome background
Primary request: Heartlands sunny pastoral pond with dense reeds and a warm timber dock.
Scene/backdrop: welcoming rural freshwater pond; sunlit meadow banks, soft rolling countryside, clusters of reeds and cattails, a simple warm honey-brown timber dock entering only from one edge.
Lighting/mood: clear warm afternoon sunlight, pastoral, calm, inviting.
Color palette: fresh greens, warm straw gold, gentle sky blue, amber timber.
Style/medium: Modia fantasy ink-and-wash watercolor illustration, bold hand-inked outlines, layered translucent watercolor washes, subtle aged parchment paper texture; clearly painterly 2D artwork.
Composition/framing: exact 4:3 landscape game background designed for an 800x600 logical viewport; shoreline, vegetation, rocks, dock or pier frame the outer edges and upper third; keep the central and entire lower half as broad unobstructed open water for bobber, line, ripples, fish shadows, and gameplay effects; no focal object in the center; full-bleed, no border.
Constraints: environmental background only. No characters, people, creatures, fishing rods, fishing lines, bobbers, hooks, boats, visible fish, leaping fish, UI, interface panels, icons, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks. No photorealism and no 3D rendering.
